title: 49ers are favorites to win the NFC West, but Rams remain favorites to win the Super Bowl

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers are favorites to win the NFC West, but Rams remain favorites to win the Super Bowl
sources.description: The 49ers' Week 1 win over the Rams resulted in a shift in betting odds, but perhaps not as big a shift as some would think.
